issues.title: Restore qa-debt quality gate contract
issues.outcome: Makefile exposes qa-debt, test-coverage, security-check, and cleanup targets without increasing debt budgets.

issues.title: Remove tracked compiled artifacts from scripts/docs/build
issues.outcome: Tracked __pycache__ pyc artifacts under scripts/docs/build were removed from the index and the docs build subtree now ignores pyc/cache outputs.

issues.title: Refresh generated module dependency map and restore drift check
issues.outcome: Generated module dependency map artifacts were refreshed from the current source tree.

issues.title: Remove hidden RuntimeClockService defaults from replay services
issues.outcome: Historical replay services now require an explicit now_factory, with composition wiring passing current_utc_time and unit tests injecting fixed clocks.

issues.title: Add branch coverage margin above the 85% blocking gate
issues.outcome: Focused branch tests were added for processed-record selector, ledger, formatting, and PromQL escaping branches. A local full coverage-verify attempt timed out after 900s before producing a fresh repo-wide coverage XML, so the committed branch gate evidence remains the previous 0-margin snapshot until CI or a successful local coverage lane refreshes it.

local_coverage_attempt.command: COVERAGE_FILE=reports/coverage/.coverage.serial python scripts/engineering/ci/run_pytest_resilient.py --target tests/ --reports-dir reports/pytest/coverage-verify --parallel-marker 'serial and not e2e and not benchmark and not memory' --parallel-addopts '-q --tb=short -p no:xdist --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/contract --cov=src/bioetl --cov-report=' --skip-serial-pass

issues.title: Reduce saturated hotspot-family fan-in budgets
issues.outcome: composition_factories_pipeline max_internal_fan_in dropped from 3 to 2 while the max_internal_fan_in budget stayed at 3.

issues.title: Align MCP local runtime config policy with tracked files
issues.outcome: MCP local runtime policy now marks .codex/settings.json and .codex/config.toml as local-only untracked surfaces unless future tracked templates are introduced.

issues.title: Fix naming gate violations and stale Make-target references
issues.outcome: Naming exceptions cover existing documented uppercase paths, error-catalog.yaml was renamed to error_catalog.yaml, and stale Make target references now resolve.

issues.title: Triage actionable duplication clusters without mechanical deduplication
issues.outcome: Duplication clusters were classified for actionability without mechanical deduplication: hotspot, full-app, and broader application/composition report-only duplication baselines are clean at zero actionable clusters.

recommended_follow_up: Keep hotspot families at zero duplicate clusters.
Treat infrastructure adapter export-facade clusters as low-risk governance visibility, not immediate mechanical deduplication.
Prioritize composition runtime wiring patterns only when changing the owning seams for real feature work.

issues.title: Simplify lazy bootstrap service registry traceability
issues.outcome: Lazy bootstrap exports now use a typed BootstrapExport descriptor instead of a raw string registry while preserving lazy import behavior.
